test_title: SSC MTS 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 11 Sept, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Which figure should replace the question mark (?) if the following figure series were to be continued? 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/84ddd8a227abd0b4f48860379cffd6395d970c3837990be7e8edfbff44cdd092.png]
solution:
The figure that will replace the question mark (?) in the following figure series is shown below:

1) For first box alternate series : 

 
• Alternately bottom left corner element and center element interchange positions.
 
• Alternately center left element and bottom center element interchange positions. 
 
• Alternately top center element and center right element interchange positions.

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/776f4ce063e2ae8d7a1e0ede2758fab0cb0366e018de6ce0c664097d2226da6c.png] 

2) For second box alternate series :

 
• Alternately center element is replaced by new element and remains constant i.e 'D' is replaced by 'V' and 'A' is replaced by '6'.
 
• Alternately all elements except center element shifts in the anti-clockwise direction.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e4bc945c6db771dd15895cb81824efc6d14e61bdbe779bfe699276b789ca081f.png] 

The final series is :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/91b4a13c2d552ddd51dbf9ccecc816f928063a7f502d53b04317e17120e1b7ba.png] 

Hence, ‘option - (3)’ is the correct answer.
